notes: Cliopatria has no Griqualand East. One page opened. Dates conflict inside the page (1860-63 trek; 1862 laager; Kokstad 1872) and the annexation is a span (British control 1874, Act 1877, promulgation 17 September 1879); the dossier ends at the 1877 act, matching the Cape dossier's gain of 1877. The event 'capital_move' in 1874 is a marker for the British assumption of control, not a move (the page gives no second capital). Capital coordinate is the researcher's own, flagged. Region name Griqualand East is used by the Cape dossier too (gazetteer to add). The 1878 rising is not on the page.
